setup.text: The forge bench holds a billet glowing orange in the fire, gripped steady by tongs while a trough of spring water waits beside the anvil. Ilsa turns the metal once more in the coals to check its color before swinging it to the anvil.

option_a.text:
The player asks, "Does it matter how hot?"

Ilsa tests the heat against the metal. "Glowing, not just warm."

option_b.text: The player offers a second river stone that has been warming near the fire. Ilsa takes it and works the metal against the stone. The surface hardens evenly under her hands.

option_c.text: The player picks up a stick from the ground and holds it toward the quench trough. The wood absorbs the water without change, remaining unchanged and soft.
